Anna — thanks for the files and the clear summary. Quick answers and next steps from our side:

- Preferred VAT treatment: Redwood will accept reverse-charge (customer accounting) for EU vendors provided we have the vendor VAT certificate and a signed EU tax residency attestation. Please send the VAT cert (you attached) and a short statement that ResellCo is VAT-registered in the Netherlands and will not charge VAT to Redwood under reverse-charge rules.

- PO number format: AP requires a 10-character PO (e.g. RDW-0001234). Please include the PO on line 1 of the invoice and in the invoice PDF metadata. We will share the first PO number for the pilot once onboarding is complete.

- Invoicing endpoint: send invoices to invoices@redwood.com (AP mailbox). For the supplier onboarding record please cc procurement@redwood.com.

- PO netting: we sometimes use invoice netting for multi-line reseller settlements (applies when contract indicates consolidated settlement). Since this is the first month, we will process the invoice gross (invoice amount = margin due) and apply netting rules for month-end settlements if both parties agree. Please note netting requires a signed mutual action plan (MAP) and legal sign-off.

Attachments: I[0m attached our onboarding checklist to help speed the AP validation. Once you send the signed attestation and a final sample invoice (with the PO placeholder) we can create the supplier record and issue the test PO.

Thanks,
